text: If you receive this augmentation, your intelligence and willpower will be increased by a small amount. It will cost you 100,000 gold. Do you wish to do this?
If you receive this augmentation, your intelligence and willpower will be increased by a small amount. It will cost you 100,000 gold. Do you wish to do this?
I do not believe you can afford this augmentation. It is 100,000 gold.

You seek a way back to Nirn? Tricky, very tricky. The Clockwork King does not suffer unintentional apertures, and it would take a very strong planar traveler to reach this place. Hm. Perhaps I may have a solution. Fyr Manor is yours, for the time being, and the great wizard who claimed it had a way to and from his private tower on Vvardenfell. I can reactivate this portal, but be wary: I know not where it leads.
I have reactivated the portal that Lord Fyr used, you may find it in Fyr Manor's foyer.

Give them water and they watch after themselves! Quite amazing really, I believe the friction from the wind causes them to generate electrical sparks, though never enough to be painful, and never enough to harness for magical properties. No doubt this is why the Aboretum saw fit to kill them.

I-
Hm. I did not consider if
No-
But it is a possibility!
N-no!
But I trust you. Very well, it will not hurt.
Y-yes it will!
I shall take this cure, if you think it so... important.
No!
Yes!

(He sighs)
I thought it would come to this. It seems that in your eagerness to help me, %PCName, you yourself have become infected, and now project that idea onto me. It is a shame, and such delusions can only mean you yourself may be the source. If this is the case, then you must die.
Hello again, it is good you are back. I need your assistance in pruning some trees around the city. Though they are very old, they are no doubt infected.
That matter is done.

You have a choice, %PCRace. The Gardener is the source, and as such he must be cured or removed. I have fabricated such a concoction that would purge the disease from his body, but it must be taking willingly. Convince him to do so, but if you have no other choice, destroy him. I wish it not, as he is loyal and dear to me, but if it comes to it, he must be destroyed for the good of the city.

player-> additem "sotha_cureinfection" 1

text: Find the one who spreads these rumors.
Find one who spreads these rumors, find where they found them, and where that finder found his, and so on. Though it may take time, eventually you will find he who first spread these rumors.
I hope he enjoys cleaning, because he will be doing a lot of it from now on.

He... isn't cheating? Just getting drunk?
Well that's awful! He should be here at home! I mean, yes, it is nice he was never cheating, but when gets home I am going to give him a piece of mind. Not literally, of course!
I suppose I should thank you for revealing this treachery, even if it wasn't what I thought. You could have this, it's a treasure of my husband's. Maybe it'll teach him a lesson.
Another woman... Unbelievavavable...

Huh? 'Nother woman?
Listen bub, I been married for a long time, and I love m'wife, but sooner or later a guy has to take a break from life. So don't blame me if I want to go out and drink some good ole water w' my friends and get away from it all. A man needs his space, but that doesn't mean he's seeing someone else. Go tell her that.

Mogan-679 usually wanders around the Residential District, but I swear my husband slips off and meets with some younger girl during the night. Other people kept saying he's leaving bottles out everywhere, they must be some sort of gift, maybe they'll leave a trail. Find her, kill her, make him know what happens if he's disloyal.

Fourteen years we've been married and not once have we had problems. But now, every night he sneaks out to go somewhere, and thinks I don't notice! He comes home, bottles in hand, giving excuses. He has to be cheating, and I know he is! Would you be a dear and follow him? If you find that hussy he's eloping with, you have my permission to kill her. 

Oh, his name? Mogan-679.
I already told you how to reach it, leave me alone.
Well, I see you speak the language of business. Very well, I'll let you up there. The old teleporter will take you up.
Well, I doubt you'll break anything. Alright, I'll let you in. The old teleporter will take you up.

Let me think about it again. 
Uh.
No.
With those arms? Please. I'd be more scared of you getting hurt just punching me.
Alright, alright. Just calm down. If you're so set in your ways, the old teleporter will take you up.

Access? Why? No, wait, wait. How?
What makes you think I can give you access to the upper Clocktower? Do you see a ladder or staircase going up friend? No. That's because it's off-limits, and not actually possible. And even if there was, say theoretically, some sort of way up, I wouldn't tell you.

text: This glass cannot be broken by anything less than a Numidium class threat.
Speak with disrespect to the spirits, and you will regret it.
It is complete.

You have returned! And still you are unenlightened! Excellent!
You see, friend, the Lord Sotha Sil teaches us that we cannot find knowledge from faith. Faith and belief are but fuel, for though they drive us to the light, they are not the light. This is the first lesson of Sotha Sil. Knowledge must be found by one's own hand. Go now with my blessing, and find your light.
result_script:
Journal Sotha_pilgrimage 20
Player-> Addspell "sotha_blessing"
Player-> AddItem "fyr_key_shrine" 1

text: Still here? Why have you not begun your pilgrimage?

Ah! You have! Excellent! Now listen, traveler, for I will say this but once. In the Hub and Industrial Districts lie two shrines. Where, I cannot say, but know that these shrines are marked as gear shrines, points where our Lord Sotha Sil sat and taught. Go to these two shrines, pray at the gears within, and learn the lesson that is not. Then, return to me and be blessed.

Ah yes, that old thing. I don't really advertise the service anymore, but I still perform necromancy for those who commission me, which does happen on occasion. The fellow who wanted these skeletons went by the name of "Irim". Had a hood over his face, but his address was somewhere in the eastern residential district. At least, that's where I shipped the kits to.
You heard me. Knock me out, and I'll guard your little tower. Got that, kid?

Guard a tower? Hah. Kid, let me tell you, I fought demons, and fabricants, and fabricant demons, all my life. And they were always big, and grand, and majestic. Because that's what I like. Things that are above me. Things I can aspire to. Sitting there playing babysitter for a building isn't my can of oil. But, I'll tell you what. We'll have a duel. No weapons. If you knock me out, then fine, I'll try your little guard job, understand?
We need to find a new guard for the tower. Someone with experience. I don't know anyone like that, but maybe someone else in the slums does.

I brought food down to Muatra every few days. He told us that someone had to... watch over what was inside, or it might get out. But if he is gone, we will need someone new. I was.... hoping that if you had been there, you might have seen what was inside, and might know someone who could guard it? We would need a big strong man, someone capable of taking down things. But I don't know any big strong men, do you?
Urusai told me he'd start guarding the tower as soon as he "got his affairs in order". I just hope he's up to the task...

Ever talk to old Urusai-2123? He used to be a bouncer at some tavern or similar, but he retired. Strong as a hulking fabricant, and still has his ceramic greaves I hear. He lives around here somewhere, northwest corner of the slums, I believe.
If sir is tired I can turn down the lights in sir's quarters. Hooking up.
Catching up on sir's reading? I shall have the room connected and readied.

You stand in the foyer of Fyr Manor, sir. The prior owner of this fine abode was given it as a gift, from the Lord Sotha Sil, as another home for him to stay in during his visits to the city. I am sure he wouldn't mind that you own it now, sir.

This is the alchemy lab, sir. As I understand it, your predecessor was quite the mixer of potions, and as such the Lord Sotha Sil saw it fit to give him this state-of-the-art lab. If sir wishes, sir may pick the ingredients and use the available apparatus to mix sir's potions.

Your armory, sir. Here you may repair your items by activating the panel near the anvil, but perhaps more relevant to sir's wishes are the mannequins and display tables for sir's treasure. Simply speak to the mannequins, and they will certainly cooperate in dressing up in sir's armor.

This, sir, is the Atronach Arena. Your predecessor was something of an expert on daedric magics, and so this arena was constructed for him. Simply select the control panel, select which enemies sir would like to fight, and sir may subsequently enjoy the battle.

The bedroom, sir. As I understand it, those from outside the city require sleep, and as such these quarters were built for sir. One may also store their possessions on the tables and places provided if sir wishes.
This, sir, is the enchanting lab, essential for any aspiring mage. The panel near the quartz shall begin the enchanting process, and of course, sir may use the other facilities as sir wishes.

Ah sir, perhaps in sir's travels sir has acquire a pneuma, the soul-battery of a fabricant, and wondered what to do with it? Well, the prior owner did as well, sir, and this lab was thusly built. If sir has a pneuma, simply use the panel near the back of the room, and sir may deconstruct the pneuma into its base components.

Ah, this, sir, was a special gift from the Regent to you. It tracks your progress in life directly, and whenever you do something you consider an 'achievement', this room will carve a statue dedicated to it. Quite pleasing.
If sir is a reading man, sir may store their books on these shelves, or read the ones already here.
It is a lovely view out today, sir.
Yes sir! This room was a simple experiment, designed to allow warping to and from Sotha Sil for Lord Fyr. Unfortunately, we could never find the final component to punch through the void, as it were.
This is the power core, sir! If you'll excuse me, sir, the mechanisms that power it are very advanced, and I'd feel safer if sir did not touch it.
Hello, sir! Nice of you to visit! This is the room where my machinery is stored. I'm afraid it isn't used for much else!

A joke between Lord Fyr and Lord Sotha Sil, I believe. Fyr was never a religious man, sir, so a gift of a religious shrine was taken as a light joke at his expense. Nevertheless, it has been kept, as it may prove useful to sir nowadays.
A throne room, sir, if sir is inclined to feel like a ruling king.
Very well, consider myself flattered.
You do right to honor the ancestors.
Extant.
To call it a work of art insults it. It is the greatest creation any mer or god could hope to devise.
The clockwork city is the world of Sotha Sil, the Clockwork God-king in Quartz. It stands outside of space and time, and it is a haven for those seeking knowledge.

His lair is as puzzling as the mind of the Sorcerer himself. Ever-moving, ever-changing, its levers and gears responding to its master's will alone. It is here he performs his profane experiments, aided by his magic and tainted by his madness.
The matter was dealt with.

This district supplies livestock to the rest of the city, but we are not always successful. The infection ruined one poor soul's endeavors, but perhaps it spawned that ruination. It is on the southern side of the Arboretum. Investigate it.

Indeed we know the reason why! It is a sign of the end times. Our Lord Seht has finally determined that we must destroyed, like all other experiments! And so he has sent that which has already been destroyed to do so!

We have attempted to assist those attacked, and have built analytical machines, but we have had no success in tracing anything. Rest assured, were we responsible for or knowledgeable about the armies of dead that march across the district, they would not be so poorly constructed.

Ponder what tragedies have befallen us! No changes in these dark times have truly occurred, yet the bones of the past attack us for revenge we have not committed! But why? Why what we wonder? And yet no answers come to us! But wonder not about our wondering, from when an answer is wondering from the wonder, we shall inform you!
Tragic, but nothing we have not seen before. Our ancestors are angry, but the source of their anger is unknown to us. We will sit and watch, and if we know more, we shall tell you.

Hm. Perhaps showing you the bones wouldn't be enough. An example then perhaps? Normal logic says "two plus two equals four". Nonsense logic says "two plus two equals fish". Now, while it seems stupid, understand that two plus two will always equal fish. Nonsense logic follows nonsensical, but nevertheless consistent rules. Not like unlogic. With unlogic, two plus two can equal anything. It is horrible, messy. No wonder the dwemer liked it.

A beautiful piece of dwemer craftsmanship, the last one! And I know it's here in the city. But oh, weep for poor Numinar, for it lies deep within the Watchman's Headquarters, and only Watchmen may get in! I have tried for weeks to enter, with no success! They'd have to think you one of them to-
Hm. Hmm. Yes, you have the right build, the right posture. Tell me, would you like to help me in my work?
One armory to be connected, sir. The mannequins have been practicing, and it does show I must say, sir.
Connecting. Sir is certainly a pious sir.

An ancient and often lost art. Sotha Sil himself was said to be the last, but this shall soon no longer be the case. They are the healers of time, those who ensure linear events happen favorably, or sometimes even happen at all. It is appropriate that the ultimate fate of a clockwork city is to make sure that clocks work properly, I find.
This will end badly for you, you understand that, yes?
Indeed, mortal, death is bitter. But your time will come.
I'll give it to one of the temple charities, if that's acceptable.
Yes, money. Exactly what I wanted. How did you know?
Never... make... assumptions. Know... the... truth... in... everything... before... you... go... forward.
Hm... What would I tell myself? Oh, I know! "Always be yourself". That's good advice.
Don't talk. Talk is useless breaks concentration no talking more stacking!
Trust no one. Everyone will betray you.
Buy low, sell high! And I am selling and buying for TODAY only!
*Plunk* *Plink* *Ka-CLANK*
Water or ground doesn't matter, we've been falling for so long either one will kill you when you land in it. Not that you'll ever land.
Make sure you perform something when you're at your best. If you're sick or diseased, disaster may strike.
Keep an open heart and mind; the city's got a lot of love to give, almost as much as I do.
Heal as often as possible, you don't want that precious blood to spill.
All the blood that the cows carry is meant for pulling levers and running from the levers that you pulled.
Don't just carry purely harmful spells with you. Always treat your spellbook like a toolbox. It should have things for all situations.
If you can eat something, do it. I'm gonna guess you're an adventurer, and when you adventurers are out in the world, you're not left to dine on fine food, am I right?

Always take risks. After all, you never know until you try. Except for me. I don't know that I've tried until before I did so.
Or something. B'seht, that last sentence screwed with my mind.
The stock have always told me that should I ever slaughter a fabricant, to always check for their elixir, the fluids that allow them to move. They're quite useful.
Alwaysssss avoid thosssse who would abussssse your powersss, be not a pawn, but a player.
No?
Stay away from the seas, friend, or you'll end up lost like me.
Don't talk to statues.
Stop talking to me.
Stay sober.
Always confide in close family, not because they won't betray, but because there's only slightly less guilt when you tear them apart for betraying you.
Nope. Even with what I've done I'm not that good. Superheating skin renders many things useless.
Unneeded.
Economy of action will get you far. Do not take superfluous action, and do not speak to uninteresting people.
Just because Hrothmund's Bane is magically sealed, that doesn't mean there isn't something inside waiting for you. Be ready for a fight.
Transicants... fabricants... there... is... no... outward... difference.
How can I tell myself a secret if I already know it?
Best part of stacking is knocking down stacks so you can stack again. Queues are like stacks but more efficient no data structures not what is needed have to stack.
Secrets come from treasure, experiences, or otherwise. We have none. We have only run.

Well I have to tell you I just got... hold on, lean in closer. (He begins to whisper) I have a special, incredible object, on sale, today, for one day only! A dagger of legend, wielded by Nerevar himself! The Ethos Knife of Commerce, an incredible artifact, for you only!
*Whir whir whir whir whir whir* *Pewssssssssh*
I once had a parachute, but I lost it somewhere. Not that it matters, nobody ever stops falling.
I have heard there is a way to become immune to disease. I doubt it works, though.
Of my numerous old lovers, one told me that there exists in the city a gear of pure perfection. Might be fetch a pretty penny with a collector.
I hear that deep within the city lies a pendulum fashioned from quartz. How I wish to see such a thing.
If you mix together two things with the same properties, you get something. I think?
A useless piece of paper is hiding with a man who is going backwards and forward, deep below a face that isn't mine.
I heard deep in the catacombs that an incredible treasure may be found. I may go seek it out some day.
I once saw a beautiful mess of delicious gold and treasure, but it was locked up by a few Watchman a while back. A shame really, it looked quite tasty.
You yourself have a path to walk in the future, %PCName, and soon you will find yourself deciding far more than you realize.
Sometimes I think that maybe, maybe I'm just hallucinating my abilities, but then the stock calm me down.
I sssssssaw sssssome ssssort of black rock floating down in the canalssssss. Probably ssssomeone'sss valuablesssssss.
Please don't hurt me.
I used to have a brother, who thought himself lost in a huge forest, but really was just stuck in a house with some metal trees! Hilarious, but tragic.
Sometimes I wish I was a fountain, which is another type of statue.
I actually have a passion for raising fish.
Sometimes I wish I weren't always drunk.
Apparently one of us is a girl. Neither he nor I will admit to it, though, and if one of us denies it, how will you know if they're lying?
Saw a fabricant mudcrab the other day. Didn't know we were making those.
I do not spare words.

The City is far greater than that which you can see. We are in a space-that-is-not-a-space. The City is built in the body of God. Tread carefully and with reverence, but always keep an inquisitive spirit. Dig deep.
The name of the wolf that killed Hrothmund is "Ondjage." You'll need to say his name to enter Hrothmund's Barrow. Say any other name and you'll NEVER be able to get in!
(Shrug)
Only the weight of the world, friend. Rumors come and go, but they're just rumors. Not imperfects, not facts.
Rumors... are... not... needed. Only... deal... in... truths.
Oh me, you're so silly. You know anything I hear while asleep isn't worth repeating!
No time busy stacking chairs on chairs tables on tables nothing else matters.
We have heard nothing. We avoid people. For good reason.
*Whirrrrr* *Clunk clunk clunk* *Clankclank* !
Some other people who have been falling sometimes float next to me, but they never tell me much. They think they're not falling. But, we all are.
I've been bedridden for too long, I wouldn't know who or what is happening.
Babe, the only place my ear is is on someone else's head. I don't hear much, but I feel everything.

There's been talk of something evil over in the other districts. I wonder what it bleeds. If there is just one evil. Perhaps it's different veins, all flowing the same way. A league of evil as it were. Though I doubt that exists, despite how... bloody, it would be.
Sotha Sil has been talking about how he's going to build another new district, call if the Industrial. Or did that already happen?
I heard a lot of little lights lost their father, but he's still around, just inside of them.

I've heard that the undead in the catacombs are actively hunting down people. Disturbing, but any instance of an undead attack is usually provoked. They're docile unless disturbed. Like bees, or my mother.

That's like asking an apple-grower to tell you about apples! There's so many little tidbits and morsels to pick and chew. Hm...
Well, I've heard that somewhere in the city lies a mystical plant, that when consumed, grants you ancient knowledge of ole Seht himself. Wonder what it tastes like.
The Eternity has said that a possible dwemer aethership might still be active in Sk- Oh wait, sorry, that hasn't happened yet.
As I've already said, I've heard tales that outside of the city the fabricant livestock are going crazy. That probably means something has riled them up, or is outright controlling them.
I don't really like talking to people but I hear from the general banter of crowdssssss that ssssomething is amisssssss. Jusssst a general feeling of anxiety, you know?
I don't know? I uh, don't get out much.

I've heard tongues wagging that Lord Dumac and Lord Indoril are feuding over something. I wouldn't give any thought to it, myself; the two are old brothers-in-arms, and dear friends. It would take something massive to drive a wedge between the two. Their friendship alone has ensured the survival of Resdayn.
No rumors on the high seas, sera! If anything, it's you who should be giving me the latest gossip!
I don't get around much, being a statue.
I heard a rumor that I will remove your lungs and feed them to you. I hope it is true.
Saw a thing fall out of the sky. Probably killed some poor soul. Ah well, it ain't me.
City's got a problem or two. But it always does.
Unimportant.
You may have earned my words, but sometimes I have none.
The clockseller has been asking around for imperfections these days; he even accepts them for payment, I hear. I don't really know what all it's about, though.
I've heard that someone in the hub district's been experimenting with magicka-infused plants lately. I'm really interested in hearing where his research goes, if anything comes of it.
The Abstemious and the Overclockers are really gearing up again. I don't know what's got them all riled up this time, though. I wish they'd stop. It makes me uneasy when they start fighting again.

It's really ghastly. There've been some awful murders in the residential district lately, and no-one seems to know anything. What are the Watchmen good for if they can't even keep order? That's what they're built to do!

Some poor f'lah ended up stranded in the City again. Tumbled through the wrong doorway or something, couldn't find his way out. He seems terrified of us, though, so the only way anyone can talk to him is by acting as though we think he's just another fabricant. It's kinda sad, really. I hear he's holed up in the hub district now.
I've heard that Pevlar over in the industrial district is asking around for help around the shop. If you need the coin, or just a discount, you might want to go see what it's all about.

There's been talk around the Arboretum that someone's running a fighting ring. Bloodsport. Pheh. Don't see the appeal, don't see it at all. No point. But I hear that the Abstemious are really angry about it, and want it shut down.

Quartz is one of the rarest materials in the City, if not this reality. Well, barring those materials that are only created once for a specific experiment, so let's just say one of the rarest common materials in this reality. Anyway, smiths are always looking for it, and  will pay a premium if you happen to find any.
